recognize_zh: 與旁邊的小淋巴球相比，右側細胞團體積巨大，細胞質內大型淡染空泡把深染細胞核擠成新月形貼邊（印戒細胞）；左側另有一顆大型、細胞質濃密深染的圓形腫瘤細胞。
features: Cluster of very large atypical cells, many times the diameter of an adjacent small lymphocyte
Large clear to pale intracytoplasmic vacuoles displacing nuclei into peripheral crescents (signet ring cells)
Separate large round cell with dense, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and indistinct overlapping nucleus
Hyperchromatic nuclei with smooth contours; nucleoli obscured by dense staining
Background with a few small lymphocytes and scant debris
describe_en: Cytospin of ascitic fluid shows large atypical cells that dwarf the background small lymphocytes. On the right, a cohesive cluster of cells contains large pale intracytoplasmic vacuoles that compress hyperchromatic nuclei into crescents at the cell edge, giving a signet ring configuration; on the left, a single large round cell with dense basophilic cytoplasm is present. Dense staining obscures nucleoli. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma with signet ring cell differentiation; the primary site requires correlation with cell block immunocytochemistry and imaging.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells are smaller, have centrally placed nuclei and two-tone cytoplasm with a lacy edge, and are calretinin/WT1 positive, lacking mucin vacuoles that indent the nucleus.
Lobular carcinoma cells are usually smaller and arranged singly or in chains with targetoid intracytoplasmic lumina, and are GATA3/ER positive with E-cadherin loss.
Lymphoma cells are discohesive with scant cytoplasm and lymphoglandular bodies in the background, and are CD45 positive and keratin negative.
